title: How to implement a callback after execution of a widget
body: Hi, I'm using a rangeSlider to filter the hits and I would like to display the interval price chosen by the user To achieved that, I think I need a callback on the currentRefinedValues widget. Do you know How I could do that and if it is my best option?

comments.body:
Hi @beHappyBeLindy thanks for contributing to the project with this issue. To customise the way the values are displayed you should use the CurrrentRefinenements connector: [connectCurrentRefinements](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/connectors/connectCurrentRefinements.html)

It is an higher order component that let you completely customize the view of this widget based on your understanding of your search interface.

Thanks a lot @bobylito for this quick answer. But unfortunately, I'm not using react in my project. 
Is there another existing solution with basic Js?
@Jerskouille I believe you solved a similar problem inside shopify? I do not remember the right way to do this (merging numeric refinements in this widget). Can you help us?

Oh I didn't with Shopify, I just actually indexed price ranges as strings.
But I'm pretty sure this can be failry easily done with a custom widget that would call [`getNumericRefinements`](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/reference.html#SearchParameters#getNumericRefinements)`('price')`.
Thanks @Jerskouille, Helper is really powerfull, it helped a lot !

Happy to have helped you! @bobylito is the one who did an awesome job with the helper.
I'll close the issue, feel free to reopen it any time. :)
